# Usage

<!-- This is generated by scripts/generate-usage.sh. Don't edit this file directly. -->

```console
$ ghomfc --help
NAME:
   ghomfc - GitHub Organization Members' Followers Counter

USAGE:
   ghomfc [global options] [command [command options]]

VERSION:
   1.0.1

COMMANDS:
   run         List a GitHub Organization members and sort them by the number of followers
   version     Show version
   help, h     Shows a list of commands or help for one command
   completion  Output shell completion script for bash, zsh, fish, or Powershell

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --help, -h     show help
   --version, -v  print the version
```

## ghomfc run

```console
$ ghomfc run --help
NAME:
   ghomfc run - List a GitHub Organization members and sort them by the number of followers

USAGE:
   ghomfc run <GitHub Organization Name>

DESCRIPTION:
   List a GitHub Organization members and sort them by the number of followers.

   $ ghomfc run <GitHub Organization Name>


OPTIONS:
   --format string  output format (json, table) (default: "json")
   --help, -h       show help
```

## ghomfc version

```console
$ ghomfc version --help
NAME:
   ghomfc version - Show version

USAGE:
   ghomfc version [options]

OPTIONS:
   --json, -j  Output version in JSON format
   --help, -h  show help
```

## ghomfc completion

```console
$ ghomfc completion --help
NAME:
   ghomfc completion - Output shell completion script for bash, zsh, fish, or Powershell

USAGE:
   ghomfc completion [command [command options]]

DESCRIPTION:
   Output shell completion script for bash, zsh, fish, or Powershell.
   Source the output to enable completion.

   # .bashrc
   source <(ghomfc completion bash)

   # .zshrc
   source <(ghomfc completion zsh)

   # fish
   ghomfc completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/ghomfc.fish

   # Powershell
   Output the script to path/to/autocomplete/ghomfc.ps1 and run it.


COMMANDS:
   bash  Output bash completion script
   zsh   Output zsh completion script
   fish  Output fish completion script
   pwsh  Output pwsh completion script

OPTIONS:
   --help, -h  show help
```
